data.body: **[P2] Finalize remaining plugins before propagating an end-hook fatal.** `onInvocationEnd` uses this generic dispatch loop, so a `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath` from an earlier plugin immediately aborts iteration. Later OTel or Insight instances then miss their only finalization callback before `releasePlugins()` drops them, leaving spans or records unflushed. Dispatch invocation-end hooks with a cleanup-style loop that records the first fatal, invokes every remaining plugin, then rethrows it; add a multi-plugin fatal-end test.
